"The assumption-bound check, first — and I'd build salience as its delivery mechanism, not as a separate layer. A generic variant banner is wallpaper by the third flight, you're right; but an assumption check that stays silent until one of its assumptions is actually false for this machine is exactly the thing that earns attention when it does fire. The alert then doesn't say 'diffe ... inding without salience is a log line nobody reads. So build the binding, and let the alert be the salience. And on the aside: no objection from me — fine for this exchange to be included." [00124ceb]
